statement: Intel Data Center and AI Group revenue reached $6.3 billion in Q2 2026, up 59% year over year from $3.9 billion, with operating income of $2.5 billion.
why: A 59% jump in data-center revenue at a second-tier accelerator and server-CPU vendor shows data-center spending is broad rather than confined to the leading GPU supplier.

impact.mechanism: Strong data-center revenue growth confirms end-customer buying of AI and server infrastructure is expanding, supporting the overall demand track.

evidence.source: Intel Newsroom / Intel Q2 2026 earnings release
evidence.excerpt: Data Center and AI Group revenue $6.3 billion, +59% YoY from $3.9B, with operating margin 39.5% (vs 16.1% prior year) and operating income $2.5 billion

confidence.basis: Numbers come from the earnings release but were reached through a secondary coverage page; the primary SEC filing could not be fetched.
